item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will continue to affect the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will cover Guangdong gradually. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be slightly cooler over Guangdong on Tuesday. The dry monsoon is expected to persistently bring generally fine weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week to early next week.
